plain: The power to get a result done; the ability to produce an effect

webster.text: The act of producing effects; a causing to be or exist; effectual agency.

example.quote: This circumstance will produce an entire change in the operation of requisitions, and will give them an efficiency which otherwise they could not have.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
